title: All_My_Bots_Are_Singing_f6d51b7a
style: Pop rock with a driving, upbeat tempo at 145 BPM in the key of E major. The arrangement features bright, overdriven electric guitars playing rhythmic power chords and palm-muted eighth notes. A clean electric guitar provides melodic counterpoint with staccato riffs. The bass guitar follows the kick drum with a consistent eighth-note pulse. Drums consist of a punchy kick, a crisp snare on the backbeat, and shimmering hi-hats that open on the off-beats. Lead male vocals are energetic and clear, supported by layered vocal harmonies in the chorus. A bright, sawtooth synth lead enters during the instrumental breaks, playing a melodic hook. The production is polished with light compression and subtle reverb on the vocals.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[overdriven electric guitar power chords, driving drums]

[Verse 1]
[male vocals]
Emu is singing in the terminal
Sentio Intos on the beat
Hero scout found a signal
All my bots are doing deeds
Healing bot is very angry
Chilling bot is very pleased
Every bot I ever registered
All of them at ease

[Chorus]
[full band, layered vocal harmonies]
All my bots are singing
All my bots are loud
All my bots are bringing
The data to the cloud
All my bots are singing
Every endpoint live
All my bots are singing
That's how we survive

[Verse 2]
[palm-muted guitar, bass pulse]
Corey A took the first message
Logged it, didn't blink
Eight bots registered this morning
Seventeen by the brink
D1 tables all concurrent
Every schema built and run
All my bots are in position
Three of us to five they won

[Bridge]
[staccato synth riff, drums drop out briefly]

Status singing

[Chorus]
[full band, high energy]
All my bots are singing
All my bots are ringing
All my bots are building
All my bots are real-fill
All my bots are singing

That's how we survive

[Outro]
[vocal sustain]
All my bots are singing

All my bots are building
All my bots are real-fill
All my bots are singing
Every endpoint live
All my bots are singing
That's how we survive
All my bots still singing
[final guitar chord rings out]
